parse.contract: Checked constructor state: the returned parser's remaining raw bytes equal the input sequence.

raw_pair_bounds.contract: Checked bounds for the first nonempty segment, first equals byte, delimiter boundary, skipped ampersands, and consumed prefix.

find_plus.contract: Checked first plus index, or checked absence over the complete input.

replace_plus_in_place.contract: Checked length preservation and pointwise plus-to-space replacement after the proven first plus.

byte_serialized_unchanged.contract: Checked exact classification of the unchanged URL-encoded ASCII byte set.

percent_encoded_bytes.contract: Checked all 256 output triples: percent marker, uppercase high/low hex digits, and ASCII bytes.

impl_Clone_for_Parse/clone.contract: Checked clone state: the returned Parse has the exact remaining input sequence of the original.

impl_Parse_0/into_owned.contract: Checked state preservation when converting Parse to ParseIntoOwned.

byte_serialize.contract: Checked constructor state: the returned byte serializer's remaining bytes equal the input sequence.

byte_serialize_size_hint.contract: Checked exact empty/nonempty lower and upper size bounds for the remaining byte slice.

encoded_chunks_first_run.contract: Checked decomposition of a serialization chunk model at the maximal unchanged-byte run.

string_chunk_singleton.contract: Checked mapping a single unchanged UTF-8 string chunk to its integer-byte sequence.

string_chunk_map_concat.contract: Checked map distribution over concatenation for serializer chunk traces.

cow_pair_map_concat.contract: Checked map distribution over concatenation for borrowed parser trace pairs.

owned_pair_map_concat.contract: Checked map distribution over concatenation for owned parser trace pairs.

encoded_chunks.contract: Exact logical sequence of public byte-serializer chunks, including maximal unchanged runs and singleton escaped bytes.

safe_run_end.contract: Checked maximal endpoint of the initial unchanged-byte run.

unchanged_byte.contract: Logical form of the already checked URL-encoded safe-byte classification.

uppercase_hex.contract: Exact uppercase hexadecimal digit mapping used by the chunk model.

percent_hex_value.contract: Checked mapping from one ASCII hexadecimal digit to its nibble value, or invalidity.

percent_decoded_from.contract: Indexed recursive percent-decoding model, defined on the canonical byte sequence and current offset.

percent_decoded_from_step.contract: Checked one-step equation for the indexed percent-decoding model.

percent_decoded_model.contract: Exact logical output for valid and malformed percent escapes.

byte_model_subsequence.contract: Checked mapping of a byte subsequence to the matching integer subsequence.

push_byte_preserving_map.contract: Checked Vec push transition for both raw byte view and integer-byte model.

copy_bytes.contract: Checked slice-to-Vec prefix copy preserving exact byte contents.

append_decoded_byte.contract: Checked Option buffer transition that copies the untouched prefix on first escape and appends one decoded byte.

append_literal_byte.contract: Checked literal-byte append transition that preserves borrowing until the first escape.

int_prefix_push.contract: Checked extension of an integer-sequence prefix by its current element.

percent_decode_local.contract: Local checked percent decoder preserving malformed escapes and exact output bytes.

skip_ampersands.contract: Checked logical scanner for empty parser segments.

find_byte_before.contract: Checked logical first-delimiter scan bounded by the current segment.

raw_pair_model.contract: Logical scanner model for segment name/value boundaries and consumed suffix.

parsed_trace.contract: Exact sequence of decoded public parser pairs from a remaining byte suffix.

replace_plus.contract: Cow ownership wrapper for the checked plus scan/replacement helpers.

decode.contract: Exact parser decoding composition from plus replacement through percent decoding and UTF-8 lossiness.

cow_str_into_owned.contract: Borrowed-string allocation or owned-string transfer preserving scalar content.

impl_Iterator_for_Parse/next.contract: Public parser next body: exact decoded scalar pairs, exact remaining suffix, and exact borrowed/owned flags per field.

impl_Iterator_for_Parse/next__refines.contract: Iterator refinement for the parser scalar and Cow-ownership traces.

impl_IteratorSpec_for_Parse/produces_ref.contract: Parse iterator trace relation is reflexive.
Refinement for Parse trace reflexivity law.

impl_IteratorSpec_for_Parse/produces_tra.contract: Parse iterator trace relation is transitive.
Refinement for Parse trace transitivity law.

impl_Iterator_for_ParseIntoOwned/next.contract: Public owned-parser next body: same decoded scalar pairs and exact remaining suffix, with both returned fields owned.

impl_IteratorSpec_for_ParseIntoOwned/pro.contract: Owned parser iterator trace relation is reflexive.
Refinement for owned parser trace reflexivity law.
Owned parser iterator trace relation is transitive.
Refinement for owned parser trace transitivity law.

impl_IteratorSpec_for_ByteSerialize/prod.contract: Refinement goal for the ByteSerialize IteratorSpec reflexivity law.
Refinement goal for the ByteSerialize IteratorSpec transitivity law.

impl_Iterator_for_ByteSerialize/next.contract: Public next body: exact maximal-safe-run and escaped-byte chunk sequence, including numeric ASCII plus construction for spaces, and exact remaining state.

impl_Iterator_for_ByteSerialize/size_hin.contract: Public size_hint body has exact bounds for remaining bytes.

decode_utf8_lossy.contract: Wrapper semantics for borrowed versus owned bytes and exact lossy UTF-8 output, using only the reviewed standard-library String::from_utf8_lossy model.

stdlib_models/utf8_step.contract: Checked one-step UTF-8 scalar decoding and maximal-subpart byte consumption.

stdlib_models/utf8_lossy_model.contract: Checked exact scalar sequence for lossy UTF-8 conversion.

stdlib_models/utf8_is_valid.contract: Checked recognition of complete canonical UTF-8 input.

impl_Target_for_String/as_mut_string.contract: String Target accessor preserves both the initial borrow relation and final mutable contents.

impl_Target_for_String/as_mut_string__re.contract: Trait refinement for String Target accessor.

impl_Target_for_String/finish.contract: String Target finish returns the same final String value.

impl_Target_for_String/finish__refines.contract: Trait refinement for String Target finish.

impl_Target_for_refmut_String/as_mut_str.contract: Mutable String Target accessor preserves initial and final borrow/content prophecy relations.
Trait refinement for mutable String reference Target accessor.

impl_Target_for_refmut_String/finish.contract: Mutable String Target finish returns the same mutable reference.

impl_Target_for_refmut_String/finish__re.contract: Trait refinement for mutable String reference Target finish.

plus_model/no_plus_identity.contract: Checked identity case of the plus replacement model when no plus occurs.

plus_model/plus_result_exact.contract: Checked pointwise and length bridge from replacement output to its sequence model.

cow_pair_singleton.contract: Checked scalar-map equality for a singleton borrowed parser pair.

owned_pair_singleton.contract: Checked scalar-map equality for a singleton owned parser pair.

encoded_chunks_first_escaped.contract: Checked decomposition of the serializer model for a leading escaped byte.

skip_ampersands_endpoint.contract: Checked endpoint uniqueness for a concrete skipped-ampersand prefix.

find_byte_before_endpoint.contract: Checked endpoint uniqueness for a concrete first-delimiter scan.

ascii_three.contract: Checked universal ASCII bound from the three exact byte positions of an escaped serializer chunk.

byte_int_prefix_push.contract: Checked concrete byte-to-integer prefix extension used by percent-decoder loop invariants.

tail_prefix.contract: Checked normalization of nested suffix/prefix slices into a direct input subsequence.

parsed_trace_step.contract: Checked one raw-parser step against its decoded trace and exact suffix model.

encoded_array_model.contract: Checked mapping of a concrete uppercase percent-encoded byte triple to its logical ASCII chunk.

slice_range.contract: Checked concrete parser slice extraction against its direct source subsequence.

parsed_borrow_trace.contract: Exact Cow ownership trace aligned with the raw-parser pair boundaries.

parsed_borrow_trace_step.contract: Checked one ownership-trace parser step against decoded Cow borrow predicates.

cow_pair_borrow_singleton.contract: Checked mapping a singleton Cow pair to its two borrowed/owned flags.

cow_pair_borrow_map_concat.contract: Checked distribution of Cow ownership observation over concatenation.

slice_after_equals.contract: Checked extraction of a nonempty query value as the exact subsequence after `=`.

empty_slice_at.contract: Checked extraction of an empty query value as the empty sequence.

native_differential.limits: Finite observed correspondence only; not an all-input equivalence proof.

standard_library_assumptions: Creusot/creusot-std 0.13 integer, u8, slice and mutable-slice models.
Reviewed standard-library content, ownership, and UTF-8 contracts in verification/assumptions.md.

excluded_generated.impl_Debug_for_ByteSerialize/fmt: Derived Debug formatting has not yet been given an explicit checked model.

goal_inventory_validation: Fresh proof.json roots are recorded per target; audit reconstructs each complete root inventory from saved Coma with Why3.
limitations: Serializer and EncodingOverride are excluded because the exact dynamic callback type cannot translate.
Derived ByteSerialize Debug, individual standard-library default bodies, allocation/pointer identity, OOM, and all-platform behavior remain excluded.
Finite differential observations do not prove upstream equivalence for all inputs.
